Nivel de vechime: Nivel mediu de experiență

Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT și Operațiuni și întreținere pentru sisteme IT
Join ORTEC 
 At ORTEC, we help organizations navigate operational complexity. Through optimization software and decision intelligence expertise, we make work flow. Every day, our software supports planners, drivers, nurses, shift workers, and other professionals by transforming complexity into clarity and flow, from fairer schedules to more efficient operations.
 Our values are more than words. They shape how we work, how we hire, and how we show up for customers every day. We build trust through honesty and accountability, strengthen our community through collaboration, embrace challenges with grit, explore new possibilities with curiosity, and strive for excellence in everything we do.
 Your role 
 As a System Engineer in ORTEC's Hosting Operations Center, you support and continuously improve the hosted SaaS platforms used by approximately 400 international customers. You help manage an infrastructure of more than 4,000 servers across cloud environments and ensure that our services remain available, secure, reliable, and performant.
 This is a hands-on role combining infrastructure administration, operational support, security, automation, and continuous improvement. Beyond day-to-day operations, you will identify improvements, automate repetitive work, contribute to technical projects, and help the hosting platform evolve.
 Your team and projects 
 You will join the Hosting Operations Center, the operational team responsible for ORTEC's hosted SaaS environment. You will collaborate with system engineers and other technical teams to resolve incidents, implement infrastructure changes, strengthen security, and improve platform resilience.
 Your work will cover both operational continuity and longer-term improvements, including patching, monitoring, disaster recovery, automation, compliance evidence, and modernization across Microsoft and cloud technologies.
 What you will do 
 · Administer and maintain Windows Server, Microsoft SQL Server and database instances, and Microsoft Azure infrastructure.
 · Deploy, configure, resize, maintain, and decommission servers and infrastructure services.
 · Manage Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, IIS, RDS, DFS, SFTP, and Microsoft Entra ID.
 · Plan and perform Windows operating system and third-party application patching, including assessment, implementation, validation, and rollback preparation.
 · Monitor availability, capacity, and performance using Checkmk, centralized logging, and related monitoring practices.
 · Investigate complex incidents, troubleshoot infrastructure issues, perform root cause analysis, and manage technical cases and changes through internal ticketing and change-management processes.
 · Support infrastructure security through Trend Micro, firewall controls, certificate management, vulnerability remediation, and infrastructure hardening.
 · Participate in disaster recovery, backup and restore testing, operational readiness activities, the on-call rotation, and major-incident support.
 · Use PowerShell and automation to reduce manual operational work, while maintaining documentation and evidence required for ISO 27001 and SOC 2 compliance.
 Who you are 
 Must-have experience 
 · At least three years of relevant experience in system engineering or enterprise infrastructure operations.
 · Strong knowledge of Windows Server, Active Directory, and Group Policy.
 · Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure, including virtual machines, networking, storage, DNS, load balancing, Microsoft Entra ID, and Automation Accounts.
 · Good networking knowledge, including TCP/IP, DNS, routing, VPNs, and firewalls.
 · Experience with monitoring, infrastructure security, backups, and disaster recovery.
 · Strong troubleshooting, analytical, and problem-solving skills.
 · A proactive, service-oriented approach and the ability to take ownership of technical issues.
 · Good written and spoken English and the ability to collaborate across technical teams.
 · Willingness to participate in an on-call rotation.
 Preferred experience 
 · PowerShell scripting and infrastructure automation.
 · Microsoft SQL Server administration.
 · Experience with Trend Micro, Checkmk, WSUS, or Endpoint Central.
 · Linux administration and high-availability or disaster-recovery architectures.
 · Experience working with ITIL, ISO 27001, and SOC 2 processes.
 Education and certifications 
 Relevant Microsoft certifications, such as AZ-104, AZ-305, AZ-900, or SC-900, are an advantage
 What we offer 
 · A competitive salary of RON 14.000 - RON 16.000 month gross monthly - depending on interview evaluations.
 · This role involves working in shifts between 07:00 and 22:00, as well as participation in an on-call rotation and scheduled maintenance interventions . On-call duties and maintenance interventions are compensated additionally in accordance with the applicable company arrangements.
 · Meal tickets.
 · Performance-based annual bonus (up to one full salary).
 · A dynamic, technical, and intellectually stimulating environment.
 · Opportunities for continuous skill development in customer service and technical areas.
 · Exposure to real-world problem-solving in diverse industries, including retail, logistics, healthcare, energy, and more.
 · A unique and inspiring work experience in an open and creative environment.
 · Smart, enthusiastic, and fun colleagues.
 · Work-life balance and flexible scheduling.
 · Career development opportunities, including job rotation and performance-based growth.
 · Hybrid work model (office in Bucharest) with relaxation areas and on-site perks.
 · Social and wellness benefits, including private medical insurance, sports benefits, and a Bookster subscription.
 · Annual team events (teambuilding, summer party, Christmas party).
 Interested? 
 Ready to make work flow? Apply through our careers site with your CV and motivation letter and discover what you can contribute at ORTEC.
 For questions about the role or application process, contact Recruitment@ortec.com .
 Life at ORTEC 
 Join a global community of professionals working across countries, cultures, and disciplines. At ORTEC, you will collaborate with international colleagues, contribute your unique perspective, and build meaningful connections across teams and borders. In an inclusive and collaborative environment, you will have the opportunity to learn, grow, and develop your career within an international organization.
